subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should oversized workspace hook metadata be silently skipped, or should discovery emit an operator-visible warning before skipping it?
rationale: The shared-helper repair is mechanical, but the diagnostic behavior for an existing hook that disappears from discovery requires hook-owner intent.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Log a concise warning for oversized package.json or HOOK.md metadata and continue discovering other hooks.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like absent or invalid metadata and omit the hook without an operator-visible diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Log a concise warning for oversized package.json or HOOK.md metadata and continue discovering other hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across hook loading, file-boundary hardening, the canonical descriptor helper, and the adjacent merged fix.
